title: Build an order fulfillment workspace
description: Combine a kanban pipeline, a payment queue, and revenue metrics into one sidebar workspace for the fulfillment team.
problem: A fulfillment team needs to move orders from requested to paid to shipped, see which orders still need payment, and watch revenue, without jumping between collection pages.
summary: Define a workspace with defineWorkspace that pairs a kanban pipeline with a filtered payment queue, metric cards, and a badge counting unpaid orders.
runtimeNotes: Declarative workspace, views, metrics, and mutation actions. No server handlers required.
intents: combine kanban and table views in one workspace
show unpaid orders count in the sidebar
add revenue metrics to an operations workspace
